purpose: Refine the near-neutral 17H SMOR clue by adding only event-relative MSS displacement-quality semantics explicitly motivated by public MSS/OB logic; preserve the entire sweep→MSS→OB-midpoint lifecycle and frozen 30-second execution.

source_basis.source: MetaQuotes — Optimizing Liquidity Raids: Difference Between Liquidity Raids and Market Structure Shifts
source_basis.logic: A valid MSS breaks opposing structure with speed and power; high-quality MSS often follows a liquidity grab.

source_basis.source: MetaQuotes — Building an Object-Oriented Order Block Engine in MQL5
source_basis.logic: Order-block validation separates displacement intensity from structural break; the impulse should show clear size imbalance versus prior quiet ranges.

frozen_base: Exact 17H C02 M1 MIDPOINT: symmetric width-2 confirmed swing sweep/close-back-inside -> first later completed close through frozen opposite swing -> last opposite-colour candle between sweep and MSS becomes OB body -> first later interaction must reach OB midpoint and close on shift side -> first executable tick at right edge.

configs.C01_MSS_BODY_GT_PREV_BODY: MSS bar directional body magnitude must exceed immediately preceding completed M1 bar body magnitude.
configs.C02_MSS_BODY_GT_SWEEP_BODY: MSS bar directional body magnitude must exceed the original sweep-bar body magnitude.
configs.C03_MSS_RANGE_GT_PREV_RANGE: MSS bar full high-low range must exceed immediately preceding completed M1 bar range.
configs.C04_MSS_BODY_GT_PREV_AND_SWEEP: MSS bar directional body magnitude must exceed both immediately preceding-bar body and original sweep-bar body.

prescreen_gate.preference: improve direct source economics while retaining at least 8 proposals; no downstream retune
